content.prompt: What is the overarching conclusion of the Azure Basics presentation regarding Azure architecture and management?
content.explanation: Azure provides a comprehensive ecosystem where physical datacenters are structured into Regions and Availability Zones, governed by a logical hierarchy (Tenant -> Management Group -> Subscription -> Resource Group -> Resource), and orchestrated via ARM REST APIs.

options.text: Azure combines physical datacenter infrastructure (Regions, Zones) with a structured logical hierarchy and ARM REST API automation to deliver reliable cloud services.
Azure consists of a single server room located in Redmond, Washington.
Cloud computing eliminates all need for network security.
Virtual Machines cannot be created or deleted after they are deployed.
